U=np.random.uniform(-2,2,(120,2)).round(2)
r=maquina.actuar(U.tolist())
Y=np.array(r['lecturas'] if isinstance(r,dict) else r)
for d in range(3):
  X=np.hstack([Y[d:-1] if d==0 else Y[:-1][d:],U[1:][:len(Y)-1-d] if False else U[1:len(Y)-d][:len(Y)-1-d],np.ones((len(Y)-1-d,1))])
for d in [0,1,2]:
  n=len(Y)-1-d
  X=np.hstack([Y[d:d+n],U[1:1+n],np.ones((n,1))]) # y[t+1+d]~y[t+d],u[t+1]
  T=Y[d+1:d+1+n]
  c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,T,rcond=None);print(d,res,c.round(2))
